title: Preferences studio
idea: Preferences studio: Searchable preference groups preview the effect of a change
audience: People who need to configure app within a desktop surface.
avoidWhen: There are only two obvious settings
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic workspace layout through its configure app priority and explicit commitment contract: Distinguish local preview from applied persistent settings
navigation: Preferences studio keeps the current configure app context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Searchable preference groups preview the effect of a change
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to configure app; many persistent preferences need organization
composition.priority: Distinguish local preview from applied persistent settings

imagery.role: Support the actual configure app context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep reset scope visible when sidebar becomes navigation
Respect window resizing, keyboard navigation and persistent document/workspace context.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the preferences studio structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no configure app content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Distinguish local preview from applied persistent settings
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized configure app content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Distinguish local preview from applied persistent settings
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active configure app context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure representative large documents/collections and resize interaction on target OS.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
